rejected_detail.title: unused local 'g' fails to compile, contradicting 162 tests green
rejected_detail.reason: FALSIFIED by direct run: odin test core at this sha compiles and finishes 162/162 tests, RC=0, no unused-var diagnostics.

rejected_detail.title: util_pct divides bandwidth units by packet-count cap
rejected_detail.reason: Premise false: bundle_cap is the STATIC SUM of tier capacity_units (bandwidth units/tick, balance.json), the same dimension as carried (queued x packet_bandwidth). Formula documented in the PR body and pinned by unit test; delegated metric definition.

findings.title: P0 record math unasserted: class loss_pct, avg_latency_ms, accumulator mapping and SLA-latch copy have no value-level pin
findings.evidence: stats_test.odin asserts only pipe math (cap_units==15, carried==queued*30, util formula, offered>=carried); zero assertions on class loss_pct / avg_latency_ms / accumulator mapping / sla latches
findings.detail: C rows are half the stream artifact; byte-identity passes on identically-wrong values, and the copy is separate from sla_evaluate - a C-row formula regression ships undetected.
findings.recommended_fix: Extend test_stats_derivation_congested: assert per class row loss_pct == dropped*100/(delivered+dropped), avg_latency_ms == total_latency_ms/delivered, the demand/delivered/dropped mapping from flow.sla, and latches == flow.sla_breach.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL (P0 ~82%, P1 ~15%, overall ~65%)
findings.evidence: N/A
findings.detail: P0: record math partially pinned (pipe math yes, class/D-row math no). P1: app emission loop 0%, PP_DEBUG compile gate 0%, stats-check manual-only, bundle replication 0%. Gate requires P0 100%, P1 >=80%.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin C-row/D-row/bundle-replication values in stats_test; wire stats-check + a PP_DEBUG build into the suite/CI; factor the app emission loop into a shared pinned helper.

findings.title: App silently ignores a dangling --stats-out token; the harness rejects the same input with a usage error
findings.evidence: app: 'if os.args[i] == "--stats-out" && i+1 < len(os.args) { stats_path = os.args[i+1] }' (no else-error) vs harness: 'if i+1 >= len(rest) || stats_out != "" { usage() }'
findings.detail: Same flag, two CLIs, inconsistent validation - the app runs with telemetry silently off on a typo'd invocation.
findings.recommended_fix: In the app parse loop, error + exit non-zero when --stats-out has no following token, mirroring the harness.

findings.title: App stats-stream write failure prints but exits 0 - the spec I/O matrix mandates eprintln + exit 1
findings.evidence: spec-5-7 line 72: 'unwritable path -> eprintln + exit 1' vs app/main.odin: 'if err := os.write_entire_file(...); err != nil { fmt.eprintfln(...) }' - no exit code change
findings.detail: Direct violation of the committed spec's app-row error contract (spec-5-7 line 72).
findings.recommended_fix: Set a failing exit code after the eprintln in the exit defer (or surface the failure so main returns non-zero).

findings.title: PR body sample excerpt contains a D row the real stream never emits; prose contradicts the P row
findings.evidence: D,21,0,0,0,1  (real stream, tick 21 - the ONLY D row; the PR body adds D,21,1,1,0,1 which the stream never emits; P,21,1 shows dropped=0 contradicting the 'shed 1 (streaming)' prose)
findings.detail: Real tick-21 stream verified: only D,21,0,0,0,1 exists; P,21,1 shows dropped=0 yet the prose says 'shed 1 (streaming)'. AC6's artifact excerpt misrepresents the stream.
findings.recommended_fix: Replace the excerpt with the verbatim real tick-21 rows and fix the pipe-1 prose.

findings.title: PR body claims a 'seed column' disambiguates appended runs; the serializer writes no seed column
findings.evidence: G row format: 'G,%d,%d,%016x,%d,%d' (tick,gen,sim_hash,score,meter) - no seed; the 'App restart appends' decision cites a nonexistent column.
findings.detail: The documented append-disambiguation mechanism does not exist in the emitted format; tick-restart + sim_hash are the only separators.
findings.recommended_fix: Either add the seed to the G row/header or fix the PR body claim (tick restart + sim_hash alone disambiguate).

findings.title: Committed spec leaves the AC5 full-suite checkbox unchecked while the PR body claims the suite green
findings.evidence: Line 109: '- [ ] Full suite: odin test core + harness build + harness run all green, goldens byte-identical -- AC5.' (unchecked)
findings.detail: Substance verified green locally by this review (162 core tests, 25/25 demos, goldens byte-identical) - the record contradicts itself; tick the box.
findings.recommended_fix: Tick the AC5 checkbox (the suite is green at this sha).

findings.title: D rows emit per drop event, never aggregated per (pipe,class,reason); the count column is always 1 despite the legend implying aggregation
findings.evidence: append(&rec.drops, Stats_Drop_Row{... count = 1}) per site; legend: '# D <tick>,<pipe>,<class>,<reason>,<count>'
findings.detail: Schema/doc mismatch on the artifact the user will diff; heavier loads emit duplicate rows with count=1.
findings.recommended_fix: Aggregate per (pipe,class,reason) per tick (sum into count), or document count as reserved/always-1.

findings.title: D-row accounting (member replication, class/reason, E22 exclusion) and offered == carried + drops*bw never asserted
findings.evidence: stats_test.odin asserts only pipe math (cap_units==15, carried==queued*30, util formula, offered>=carried); zero assertions on class loss_pct / avg_latency_ms / accumulator mapping / sla latches
findings.detail: The D-row semantics (replication to every live bundle member) are documented but untested anywhere automated.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a parallel-bundle congestion test asserting replicated D rows and the offered equality.

findings.title: Bundle-member replication semantics (pooled-bundle scenario) untested
findings.evidence: stats_test.odin asserts only pipe math (cap_units==15, carried==queued*30, util formula, offered>=carried); zero assertions on class loss_pct / avg_latency_ms / accumulator mapping / sla latches
findings.detail: No test constructs a parallel-pipe bundle, so the bundle-shared load columns are never exercised.
findings.recommended_fix: One test with a 2-member bundle asserting identical load columns + replicated D rows across members.

findings.title: App-side stats emission loop has zero automated coverage; the unit mirror mirrors the harness loop, not the app's
findings.evidence: app computes stats under 'if app.stats_live || app.overlay_on' with its own event-mark/hash logic - no test executes this path.
findings.detail: The app loop could diverge from the pinned harness path without any test failing.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract a shared per-step stats emission proc (mark, hash, compute, append) both drivers call; pin it with a unit test.

findings.title: PP_DEBUG-gated code (debug_overlay.odin, harness/overlay.odin, D toggle) has no automated compile or render gate
findings.evidence: CI: 'run: odin build app -out:app.bin' - no -define:PP_DEBUG=true build anywhere; overlay code can rot between reviews.
findings.detail: Both app builds verified compiling at this sha locally; add the gate so it stays true.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a CI step: odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true (and optionally the harness with the define).

findings.title: stats-check (the AC1 end-to-end replay-identity pin) is a manual verb, not wired into the harness suite or CI
findings.evidence: usage lists stats-check; nothing invokes it automatically (this review ran 2 demos green by hand).
findings.detail: The strongest pin exists but can silently stop being run.
findings.recommended_fix: Invoke stats-check for a demo subset (e.g. pause + qos_contention) inside harness run or CI.

findings.title: stats_check writes predictable /tmp paths (symlink-following, collision-prone; /tmp is not portable to the Windows target)
findings.evidence: live_path := fmt.aprintf("/tmp/pp-stats-%s-live.csv", demo)
findings.detail: Local dev tool risk + portability; demo name interpolates unvalidated into the path.
findings.recommended_fix: Write under gitignored bin/ (like overlay-check) or use a create-temp API; reject path separators in demo names.

findings.title: App accumulates the whole session's stream in memory, flushed only at exit (crash loses it)
findings.evidence: stats_sb grows per stepped tick on the default allocator until the exit defer writes it.
findings.detail: Write-at-exit is a documented decision; the unbounded-growth + crash-loss angle is the new cost. Availability only - sim numbers, not secrets.
findings.recommended_fix: Consider incremental append-per-tick (or per-N-ticks) flush if long sessions matter.

findings.title: overlay-check exits 0 with an overlay-free PNG when zero sim ticks were stepped
findings.evidence: wall_max=0 (cap_ms=0 or fully-paused window) -> loop skipped -> stats_valid=false -> frame rendered WITHOUT overlay, PNG written, return 0.
findings.detail: A green-looking AC3 verification artifact with no overlay in it.
findings.recommended_fix: Fail (or warn loudly) when stats_valid is false at render time.

findings.title: Demo teardown block inlined a third time instead of a shared demo_destroy helper
findings.evidence: defer { for n in d.nodes { delete(n.type_name) } ... } mirrors run_demo/load_demo_replay copies.
findings.detail: Three copies of the parse-teardown will drift.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract demo_destroy(d) next to parse_demo; use at all three sites.

findings.title: overlay-check verb missing from the harness usage string (and its required <ms> arg undiscoverable)
findings.evidence: usage(): 'harness run|save [demo...] [--stats-out <path>] | replay <demo> <log.bin> | drift-check | preview-check | stats-check <demo>' - no overlay-check.
findings.detail: PP_DEBUG builds accept the verb but never advertise it.
findings.recommended_fix: Add '| overlay-check <demo> <ms> (PP_DEBUG)' to the usage line.

findings.title: overlay_on App field is not compile-gated despite comments claiming 'field + toggle are compile-excluded'
findings.evidence: overlay_on: bool declared ungated in App; the toggle handler and draw site ARE when-gated.
findings.detail: One dead bool in release builds; comment overclaims.
findings.recommended_fix: Wrap the field in when #config(PP_DEBUG,false) too, or fix the comment.

findings.title: overlay_check re-implements the demo stepping loop and frame composition, diverging from capture_frame/run_demo batching
findings.evidence: Standalone wall-tick loop + separate BeginDrawing composition (draw_world/forecast/health/crisis_banner) duplicating run_demo's capture path.
findings.detail: Drift risk between the verification render and the capture render.
findings.recommended_fix: Share the stepping + composition helpers with run_demo's capture path where feasible.

findings.title: overlay.odin header comment says the PNG lands in _bmad-output/, the code writes bin/
findings.evidence: Header: writes a PNG to _bmad-output/overlay-<demo>-<ms>.png vs code: fmt.aprintf("bin/overlay-%s-%dms.png", ...).
findings.detail: Comment points the user at the wrong directory.
findings.recommended_fix: Fix the header comment to bin/ (gitignored, per the PR body decision).

findings.title: Spec Code Map/Tasks omit the two new harness files the diff adds (harness/stats.odin, harness/overlay.odin)
findings.evidence: Task checkboxes list core/stats.odin, stats_test, harness/run.odin, harness/main.odin, app files - not the two new harness files (the PR body does list them).
findings.detail: Spec record incomplete vs the shipped code.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the two files to the spec's tasks/code map.

findings.title: --stats-out CLI error paths untested (duplicate flag, missing token, !=1 demo, unwritable path)
findings.evidence: Parse-validation branches have no tests; only happy paths are exercised.
findings.detail: Low-risk parse guards, but they are the flag's whole error surface.
findings.recommended_fix: A few shell-level or unit tests over the parse function if it's extracted.
